content.short: Cardano NFT trading card battle game.
content.description:
PlanetPalz is a battle RPG powered by Cardano. Players will be able to battle, trade, stake and take part in guilds. All while earning Galaxy Dust, our native token, in order to trade, strengthen and upgrade their planets.

Built with Unity and playable across all devices. Inspired by games with successful infrastructures such as Runescape, Fight-My-Monsters and Clash-Of-Clans. We listen to your suggestions and feedback and intend to craft PlanetPalz according to our community.

We aim to lead the Cardano gaming industry and to do this we need time to plan, calculate, structure and test. We do not aim to rush this project as our priority is delivering an A-class game. Players will be able to battle, trade, stake and take part in guilds. All while earning Galaxy Dust, our native token, in order to trade, strengthen and upgrade their planets.
